rationale: The strongest candidates are letters assigning an economic or analytical study to an official, but their overlap with the child is limited to generic commissioning machinery. C09 requests a European industrial survey, C20 establishes a historical-study program, and C05 assigns broad coordination and policy-development work. None contains the child's distinctive consumer-dollar cost breakdown, its proposed use in labor and price disputes, or a substantially parallel sequence of provisions. The similarities therefore do not establish that any candidate materially supplied the child's drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I would like the Federal Trade Commission to launch a special investigation to give us a breakdown of the consumer's dollar.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I feel that it might be helpful if you ... should head up a group who will review on the ground in Europe industrial problems and progress
shared_material.explanation: C09 similarly commissions an economic survey from the official whose portfolio fits the subject, but the target, analytical structure, and requested output are materially different.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I will expect you to make the best possible use of existing data and government facilities under the general coordinating work of the Bureau of the Budget.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The active direction of the program should be undertaken by the Bureau of the Budget, although the preparation of the studies themselves should be carried out by the individual agencies.
shared_material.explanation: C20 shares reliance on the Bureau of the Budget and agency-based studies, but this is general administrative coordination rather than distinctive shared machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: How can we best learn what additional facts are needed in this area? And how soon can you begin work on this project?
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The first phase of our work is to determine the nature, dimensions, and significance of this problem. In the light of this understanding, we must develop the broad lines of policy
shared_material.explanation: C05 also frames an assignment as initial fact determination followed by policy work, but the language and operational program are too general to demonstrate reuse.
